author: /root/daily_operation_review
review_method: Independent model-language review of every full-body p/h2/li passage against the current English V2 source, followed by local byte/hash, HTML and link checks. This reviewer did not author or edit any of these five candidates.
language_assessment: Read the complete Romanian body. Consistent informal singular shopper address, with plural address where family members act together. The intended-fit heading uses a longer descriptive phrase for how the garment is designed to sit on the body; it is understandable and avoids inventing a snug or loose fit requirement. The Meow unit/body-versus-garment clarification is precise. No substantive language correction identified.

semantic_coverage.assessment: Gift purpose, wearer/size/included-piece checks and separate-selection caveat are retained.

All six checklist steps retain product-specific wearer options, current measurements and units/body-versus-garment distinction, cart names/sizes/quantities, no material/care inference, estimate uncertainty and current return/contact guidance.

Both product identities and sleeve suffix meanings retained. Examples do not promise current size availability. Meow warning explicitly identifies chart unit-label uncertainty and asks for unit/type clarification before size selection; no units invented. Peter Rabbit retains own-chart comparison and no transfer of a size from another design.
Unknown sizing requires recipient/parent measurements and resolution before ordering; age/usual size is not a substitute.

Child sleepwear label/intended-fit guidance, oversized loose cotton hazard attribution, no automatic size-up for growth, and lack of compliance proof from category/style are retained without new safety certification.
Care-label guidance and rejection of shared-care or predictable-shrink assumptions preserved; event/color planning retains conditional everyday Christmas-photo suggestion.
Final collection call to action requires checks for every wearer, included pieces, sizes and quantities before cart selection.

specific_meow_example_reviewed: O opțiune cu mânecă scurtă: Meow Star Garden Mommy and Me Pajamas — set cu mânecă scurtă. Deschide pagina produsului pentru a verifica pentru cine sunt disponibile opțiunile, tabelul de mărimi și piesele incluse. Unitățile indicate în acest tabel trebuie clarificate. Contactează-ne pentru a confirma unitățile și dacă valorile reprezintă măsurile corpului sau dimensiunile hainei înainte de a alege o mărime.
qualification_and_limits: Language assessment uses model multilingual competence, not human or native-speaker certification. Fluency and semantic review are not inferred from structure/hash checks.
This is an authorized complete replacement of the existing localized body, so preservation means exact before evidence and metadata scope; legacy body wording is not required to remain unchanged.

Locale prefixes are checked against the recorded article alternates and exact expected hrefs. No independent browser replay, product/support link arrival, layout or public publication verification was performed.
Review verifies fidelity to the reviewed English source; it does not establish product compliance, fabric composition, sizing units, stock availability or delivery promises.
No external mutations, commercial outcome measurement, traffic lift or sales lift are claimed.
